title: Figure 34: Gross weight vs. weight ratio to orbital for horizontal launch configurations
description: Line chart of gross weight (tons, 0-1500) versus "WR Weight Ratio to Orbital" (2.0-9.0) for payload = 7 tons, with colored curves labeled by wing loading (463.7, 561.3, 610.2, 732.0, 976.3 kg/m²) and tau values (τ = 0.063, τ = 0.200), plus shaded solution regions for vertical takeoff launchers at "TWTO = 1.35." Caption: "Figure 34. Horizontal Launch Not Practical Unless Weight Ratio is Less Than Four."
